question: Can verified No Skill Train feedback produce an evidence-bound Diagnosis, an Editor Candidate and auditable matched-condition execution in one round?
hypothesis: A shared conditional revision representation and programmatic evidence/diff checks can connect Diagnosis and Editor without historical Memory or Fusion transforms. This run does not test preconditioning gains or generalization.
task_selection: Declared before executing the Parent; same two tasks for Candidate, no selection by outcomes.
stop_rules: No Change or Need Evidence ends the round without an Editor call.
Editor No Change or Needs Revision ends construction without executing an incomplete Candidate.
Input, API, format and reference errors are technical failures, not semantic No Change.
A completed Candidate is replayed once on each declared task, without retries to select success.
recovery_reason: train:0000 ended with a model_request ReadTimeout after 28 actions. Preserve this attempt and its cost; permit one fresh same-configuration infrastructure retry, never retry a normal task failure.
